caption: The drawing features two separate compositions. In the upper section, there are three human figures; one adult figure stands behind a wooden lectern or pulpit on a brown platform, dressed in a long dark robe and a white ruffled collar, with short, dark brown hair. The adult is facing forward, while two children are seated on small brown rectangular blocks in front, each facing the adult. The child on the left has long blond hair and wears a blue dress with dark shoes, while the child on the right has reddish-brown hair and is dressed in a pinkish-red dress with black shoes. In the lower section, there is a small house or church-like building depicted in a three-quarters view. The building has an orange-brown facade, three large arched windows with visible leaded panes (two on the front, one on the side), and a set of double arched doors at the front center. The roof is steeply pitched and dark gray in color, with two metal hooks on top. The foundation or ground around the building is rendered in a light olive-green tone. The overall background of the drawing is a solid light beige color.
title: Toy School House
